title: APPEAL/2/2026 — MS SHREE LAXMI SILVER WORKS  vs. AXIS BANK
text:
Court of Registrar
DEBTS RECOVERY TRIBUNAL, JAIPUR
CHAMBER APPEAL
M/S SHRI LAXMI SILVER WORKS&ORS.
Vs
THE AXIS BANK LTD.
ITEM NO: -50
Diary No:- 117/2026
Dated:-20-01-2026
Shri Rachit Sharma, counsel for the applicant is present.
As per office report application barred by limitation but
applicant has filed an application under section 5 of limitation
act. Now Chamber Appeal be registered subject to right of
respondent on limitation point.
The matter be listed before the Hon’ble Presiding Officer
on 28.01.2026 for arguments on application u/s 5 of limitation
act.
Registrar
